## Cycle-line budget: volume integrals of the conserved state, one line per `ncycle_out` cycles (`print_cycle_diagnostics`) {#sec-ch13-cycle}

### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**What it does.** Every `ncycle_out` cycles, sums the interior conserved state times the cell volume over all
local blocks, reduces the sums to the root rank, and prints them on one line with the run-to-date meters.
**Switch.** `integration/ncycle_out`, read by pyharp's integrator; 0 turns the line off.
**Order.** Not a discretisation; exact sums up to round-off.
**Defining equation.** @eq-ch13-cycle-ke.
:::

The line is the run's own conservation record. `mass0=` is the dry mass, and `masst=` adds every species. `ke=`
is the kinetic energy and `ie=` (block line) or `energy=` (Mesh line) the total energy $E$. `pe=` is the
potential energy in a constant $x_1$ gravity. All are read from the conserved state `hydro_u`, never from the
primitives, which can be one stage stale when the line is printed.

### Derivation

Each token is a volume integral over interior cells. With $\rho_i = \rho_{d,i} + \sum_n \rho_{n,i}$ the total
density of cell $i$, $m_j$ the covariant momentum components and $V_i$ the cell volume, the two energy integrals
are

$$
\mathrm{ke} = \sum_i \frac{m_j m^j}{2\rho_i}\,V_i , \quad
\mathrm{pe} = \sum_i \rho_i\,(-g_1 x_{1,i})\,V_i ,
$$ {#eq-ch13-cycle-ke}

where $m^j$ is $m_j$ raised with the metric of the cell. Only the angle $\theta$ between $x_2$ and $x_3$ enters,
with $c = \cos\theta$, so $m^2 = (m_2 - c\,m_3)/(1-c^2)$ and $m^3 = (m_3 - c\,m_2)/(1-c^2)$. For $c = 0.5$ and
$(m_2, m_3) = (3, 4)$ the contraction is $13/0.75$ against 25 when the axes are orthogonal [check
`src/snapy_report/ch13/cycle_check.py`, output `cycle_check.out`, `[C1]`]. Both integrals weigh the total
density. Moving 0.5 of a density of 2.5 into species changes neither, while dropping it gives 1.25 times the
kinetic energy (`[C2]`). With $g_1 = -10$ and $\rho = 2.5$, pe is $25\sum_i x_{1,i}V_i$ (`[C3]`).

In the code, @eq-ch13-cycle-ke is the `ke` and `pe` of the block loop ([`meshblock.cpp:1037-1058`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1037-L1058)).

### Numerical method

See @fig-ch13-cycle-line for the tokens and their reductions.

```{python}
#| label: fig-ch13-cycle-line
#| fig-cap: "The tokens of one cycle line. The first group (sky blue) are volume integrals of the conserved state at the start of the step; the run-to-date meters (orange) accumulate over the whole run. The last column is the reduction that combines the local blocks and the ranks before the root rank prints: a SUM for the integrals and counts, a MIN for thetamin, a MAX for vicclamp. fixgrav (grey) is the gravity-work fixer total, whose budget waits for chengcli/snapy#303."
#| fig-alt: "A table-like figure listing ten cycle-line tokens, each with a coloured marker, the sum it prints and its reduction operation."
#| echo: false
from snapy_report.ch13.fig_cycle_line import make_fig
make_fig()
```

The example driver prints the line at the top of each cycle, after the cycle counter is incremented and the
step is chosen, so the sums describe the state at the start of the step, through `print_cycle_info`
([`run_hydro.cpp:161-164`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/examples/run_hydro.cpp#L161-L164)). The
line starts with `cycle=`, `redo=`, `time=` and `dt=`, and it stops there when the state holds no `hydro_u`
([`meshblock.cpp:1010-1020`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1010-L1020)).

For each local block, `print_cycle_diagnostics` adds the conserved sums, `ke` and `pe` and the meters
([`meshblock.cpp:1029-1071`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1029-L1071)). The momentum is raised with `coord_vec_raise_` and `cosine_cell_kj`
before the contraction, and the raise is the closed form above, `coord_vec_raise_impl`
([`coord_utils_impl.h:9-16`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/coord/coord_utils_impl.h#L9-L16)). `pe` is
added only with a constant gravity whose `grav1` is nonzero. Under the `SNAP_GRAVITY_WORK_RADIAL_EXACT` switch it
logs the corrected potential energy of @sec-ch06-dwork instead.

The block sums are then reduced once to the root rank, with `reduce` ([`meshblock.cpp:1073-1086`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1073-L1086)):
SUM for the integrals and the meter totals, MIN for the smallest limiter $\theta$, MAX for the VIC clamp residual.
Summing four blocks locally and then once more gives the whole-domain sums to $10^{-16}$ (`[C4]`). The printing
follows: `mass0=` always, `masst=` with species, `ke=`, the energy and `pe=` when they exist, then the meter group
after the literal ` run-to-date:` ([`meshblock.cpp:1088-1111`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1088-L1111)).

A single block prints through `MeshBlockImpl::print_cycle_info` with the label ` ie=` and 13 decimals
([`meshblock.cpp:1114-1119`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1114-L1119)). A Mesh gathers its local blocks first and prints through
`print_cycle_diagnostics` with ` energy=` and 14 decimals ([`mesh.cpp:409-420`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/mesh/mesh.cpp#L409-L420)) (`[C5]`). Both lines come
from the same function, so the Mesh line carries `ke=`, `pe=` and the meters too.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
The line is a record, not a check: nothing in the run compares two lines. A drift in `mass0=` is visible only to a
reader or a test that parses the log.
:::

1. **Solid cells.** The sums run over all interior cells, immersed-solid cells included.
2. **Restart.** The run-to-date meters live in module buffers that the restart file does not carry, so they start
   again after a restart (`sources/gh__PR_BODIES_202-219.md`, #217 Limits).
3. **Start of step.** The line is printed before the step, so the last line of a run does not show the final
   state.
